Suppose you want to retrieve the top 5 hottest posts from the subreddit "r/technology" using the Reddit API. Which Python library would you most likely use to achieve this?
You want to fetch the details of the 10 hot posts from the subreddit "r/worldnews" using the Reddit API in Python. Which is the correct code snippet from below options?

options.text:
import praw
reddit = praw.Reddit(client_id='MY_CLIENT_ID', client_secret='MY_CLIENT_SECRET', user_agent='MY_USER_AGENT')
posts = reddit.subreddit('worldnews').hot(limit=10)
for post in posts:
    print(post.title)

import requests
url = "https://www.reddit.com/r/worldnews/new.json?limit=10"
response = requests.get(url)
data = response.json()
for post in data['data']['children']:
    print(post['data']['title'])

import praw
reddit = praw.Reddit(client_id='MY_CLIENT_ID', client_secret='MY_CLIENT_SECRET', user_agent='MY_USER_AGENT')
posts = reddit.subreddit('worldnews').new(limit=10)
for post in posts:
    print(post.title)

);
